kurz: Yeast is a living fungus that turns sugar into gas and aromas. It makes dough rise.
bild_im_kopf: Like a pet with clear preferences: warm but not hot, food, and no salt straight on its head.
was_passiert: Fresh yeast and dried yeast are the same yeast, once moist, once dried. About 1 part dried yeast replaces 3 parts fresh yeast (as a guide). Less yeast and more time usually gives the better bread.
faustregeln: Do not put salt and yeast directly together.
